# uptimekuma_monitors (Data Source)

Lists every monitor, optionally narrowed to one type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every monitor
data "uptimekuma_monitors" "all" {}

# Only the HTTP ones
data "uptimekuma_monitors" "http" {
  type = "http"
}

output "http_monitor_names" {
  value = [for monitor in data.uptimekuma_monitors.http.monitors : monitor.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Only return monitors of this type, for example `http`. Omit to return all of them.

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the matching monitors, in the same order as `monitors`.
- `monitors` (Attributes List) The matching monitors, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--monitors))

<a id="nestedatt--monitors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `monitors`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is running.
- `hostname` (String) Target hostname, for host-based types.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the monitor.
- `interval` (Number) Seconds between checks.
- `name` (String) Name of the monitor.
- `parent_id` (Number) ID of the parent group monitor.
- `type` (String) Monitor type.
- `url` (String) Target URL, for HTTP-based types.
